# mBrothers

> mBrothers is a software brand used by Intrepid Parallel, Lda, in Lisbon, Portugal, "developing practical solutions for small planetary systems". It makes Windows desktop programs with interfaces in 16 languages.

## Programs

- [ExplorerFocus](https://nunex-mbrothers.github.io/ExplorerFocus/): a file explorer for Windows 11 and 10, a replacement for Windows Explorer for people who always work in the same folders. Profiles as tabs, a preview that opens almost anything, encrypted vaults compatible with Cryptomator, remote connections (SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive) and file tools. Free version with no time limit; PREMIUM adds more. More in [its llms.txt](https://nunex-mbrothers.github.io/ExplorerFocus/llms.txt).
- [The Absolute LogViewer](https://nunex-mbrothers.github.io/TheAbsoluteLogViewer/): a free Windows log viewer with live tail, regex highlight rules, split-pane comparison and context preview. More in [its llms.txt](https://nunex-mbrothers.github.io/TheAbsoluteLogViewer/llms.txt).
